text:
jonathan: Heads-up — we've got a p99 spike on /generate for hosted-api starting ~09:12 UTC. Premium customers affected, non-premium noisy but worse for premium. Suspect model-7b-quant fallback thrash. Going to try a short-lived emergency route to a lifeboat pool for premium quotas.

anna: Oncall is looking. Telemetry shows request backlog on the premium pool and elevated KV latency. Are we toggling at gateway or doing a routing policy change?

mike: Gateway override is fastest. Add a header that routes to premium-lifeboat pool, weight=100. Console toggle has a race so avoid it for this hotfix.

lex: Need to preserve usage attribution and quota counters — don't accidentally double-charge or reset tokens. Add a preserve tag or metadata on requests.

jonathan: Plan: 1) create a temporary route override matching X-RW-Tier==premium that routes to pool:premium-lifeboat. 2) add headers to indicate lifeboat and preserve usage (X-Usage-Tag). 3) set ttl=300s, monitor telemetry and errors. Rollback if 5xx > 0.5% or p99 > 700ms for >2m.

anna: Deploying override now. Command:
```bash
curl -X POST "https://gateway.internal/api/routes/override" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{
  "match": "header('X-RW-Tier') == 'premium'",
  "add_headers": {"X-RW-LIFEBOAT": "1", "X-Usage-Tag": "preserve"},
  "route": "pool:premium-lifeboat",
  "weight": 100,
  "ttl": 300
}'
```

mike: Deployed the curl.

deploy-bot: Route override created (id: r-2981) by anna at 2111111240. TTL=300s.

sre-oncall: Seeing immediate improvement for premium p99 -> ~420ms. Non-premium still high. Dashboard: https://console.internal/redwood/telemetry?panel=p99 (shortlink) :white_check_mark:

lex: Add an event-driven alert: if p99 > 700ms for >2m auto-notify and mark for rollback. Who is on rollback duty?

jonathan: I'll take manual rollback authority if errors exceed threshold (5xx > 0.5% or client-errors spike). Rollback command: `DELETE /api/routes/override/r-2981` (admin token required).

anna: Also tagging traces with X-Trace-Tag=lifeboat so we can filter logs. Adding header right now.

mike: Added gateway rate guard for lifeboat pool: 1k/s steady, burst 200. Config snippet: `rate_limit: {pool: premium-lifeboat, steady:1000, burst:200}`

sre-oncall: Errors creeping up to 0.6% (5xx). Rolling back now per threshold.

deploy-bot: Route override r-2981 removed by sre-oncall at 2111111765.

jonathan: Rollback complete. Confirming p99 back to baseline ~380ms for hosted-api. No further action for now. Follow-up: write postmortem + fix console toggle race that prevented safer rollout via UI. Also add a small runbook entry for lifeboat overrides (who can flip, telemetry checks, TTL defaults). :rotating_light: :white_check_mark:

anna: noted — I'll create the runbook and a console ticket for the toggle bug.

mike: leaving a short audit note in the routing-config changelog and adding the r-2981 entry with reason 'model fallback thrash -> lifeboat'

lex: Good. Also propose a guard in the routing API to force quota-preserve=true for emergency routes to avoid billing surprises.

jonathan: Agreed. Thanks everyone.
